The larger one has scale-pattern feathers, chased wings and a flower at the breast. The smaller one has a rope collar and a leaf-scroll panel on the wing. The title says only one is silver. No silver mark is visible, so it is unknown which one (if either) is silver and how much it weighs. The other may be white metal or plated.
